title: The agent role table names a role for a PR close and for a lint run
why: Owner 11:32 CST Nov 13, asked why the batch runner does not delegate PR closes and lint runs. The model-per-role table (agent-model-cap) names no role for either, so no agent can be briefed for them under the rules.
source: owner 11:32 CST Nov 13 via the coordinator 11:33 CST
note: Add a role, or name an existing one, for a PR close pass and a lint run in agent-model-cap, with its model and effort. Weigh: a close only ever runs from the evidence ledger (step bulk-close-needs-ledger); the 11:27 CST bulk close shows an agent with no ledger closes too much. A change to the role table is a rule change, so a lane with a reviewer. Related step operating-model-role-handoffs (owner 11:34 CST Nov 13) writes what each role hands to agents; this step names the role in the model table. Do them in one lane or in order: role table first.
